visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a teal-colored product box labeled 'FOAMING SOAP CASE' against a bright, out-of-focus background of green trees and daylight. The box shows illustrations of the soap case in use. (2) The person opens the cardboard box and pulls out a clear plastic case wrapped in a thin plastic sleeve. The environment is an indoor space with soft, natural lighting coming from a window. (3) The plastic sleeve is removed to reveal the soap case, which features a white lid with the 'uchi more' logo and two visible metal springs inside the clear body. (4) The person flips the case over to show the bottom, which is covered in rows of small, yellow-white rollers/brushes designed for lathering. (5) A blue rectangular soap bar wrapped in clear plastic is held and then unwrapped. The hands are clearly visible performing these actions. (6) The soap bar is placed into the clear case, and the white lid with springs is pressed down and locked into place, showing how the springs hold the soap against the bottom rollers. (7) Water is poured from a small measuring cup into the holes on the top of the case. The person then rolls the case over their hand and then onto the collar of a grey t-shirt, creating white foam and demonstrating the scrubbing action. (8) The scene shifts to a store shelf in Japan filled with rows of the same product, followed by a screen displaying a large QR code over a supermarket interior background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天來開箱這個「清潔刷皂盒」. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個在大型超市賣場可以買. (3) [Subtitle]: 裡面是完整一整組 不用任何組裝. (4) [Subtitle]: 上方有孔洞 可進水、也可透氣. (5) [Subtitle]: 底部直接是刷子 可以輕鬆搓出泡泡. (6) [Subtitle]: 直接來示範. (7) [Subtitle]: 盒子打開，肥皂放進去即可. (8) [Subtitle]: 彈簧的設計 讓肥皂維持在下方. (9) [Subtitle]: 裝好後記得要扣緊. (10) [Subtitle]: 使用第一步「倒水」. (11) [Subtitle]: 使用第二步「滾動刷子搓出泡泡」. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後就能開始刷洗囉 超級簡單. (13) [Subtitle]: 在日本的大型超市就能買到. (14) [Subtitle]: 想買的可參考這裡.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bouncy, upbeat electronic synthesizer melody starts with a consistent, moderate tempo. A clear female voice begins an energetic narration in Traditional Chinese. (2) A sharp 'click' sound is heard as the cardboard box is opened, followed by the light, crinkling texture of plastic being manipulated. The music maintains its energetic, happy tone under the voice. (3) A more pronounced plastic rustling sound occurs as the soap case is fully removed from its sleeve. The narrator explains the product's components with clear articulation. (4) A distinct tearing sound occurs as the blue soap bar's packaging is opened. The BGM beat remains steady with prominent synth hits. (5) A series of hollow mechanical 'clicks' and 'snaps' indicate the assembly of the soap case. The narration continues to provide instructional steps. (6) A short, liquid 'glug' and pouring sound is audible as water is added. This is followed by rhythmic friction sounds of the plastic rollers rubbing against skin and then cloth. (7) Short, high-pitched 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are peppered throughout the demo to emphasize key features. (8) The BGM swells slightly as the narrator provides information about where to purchase the item, ending on a bright, resolved musical note.
